Who I am?

I’m a graphic designer passionate about branding, logo design and social media visuals. Since 2023, I’ve been learning how to turn ideas into clean, meaningful and professional designs.

My goal is to help brands communicate their identity, stand out, and make a lasting impression through thoughtful visual design.

Experience

2023 — PRESENT

Graphic Designer

Specializing in logo design, brand identity and social media visuals. Developing creative concepts, designing promotional materials and keeping visual identities consistent for business projects — including Achgri Parfums and a professional basketball team — with clean, professional visuals that strengthen brand recognition and communication.

Selected work

PROJECT 01

Achgri Parfums

Brand identity & graphic design. One of the first projects that shaped my journey. I built visual content that reflects the elegance of the perfume industry, exploring typography, colour, composition and product presentation to attract attention and communicate quality.

Focus: brand presentation · campaign posters · product ads · visual communication

PROJECT 02

Groupe Scolaire Abid

Graphic design & visual communication. Designs adapted to the educational sector that improved my creativity and taught me how visuals can communicate information clearly and professionally.

Focus: back-to-school posters · social media posts · school branding
Industry: education

PROJECT 03

AS FAR Basketball

Sports graphic design & match-day communication. I designed match posters for a professional Moroccan basketball team playing in the DISLOG Basketball League — bold typography, club colours and dynamic player cut-outs that build hype before every game.

Focus: match-day posters · social media visuals · sports branding
Industry: professional sport
